text:
The Donald J. Trump and Jeffrey Epstein Memorial Reading Room opens in downtown D.C.

Right off the Chinatown D.C. Metro stop, a few blocks from the Justice Department, the sidewalks are filled during rush hour. Pedestrians swerve between packs of police, horns honk at teenagers blocking the street, neon restaurant signs glow. And then there’s the Donald J. Trump and Jeffrey Epstein Memorial Reading Room, where the rush hour bustle quiets.
